experiment: Cache body IDs and sphere flag in 32-byte solver pairs once per step
finding: Small repeatable gain: cached/control/cached 14.78/14.97/14.78 ms. Ring remains below 120 physics FPS; reference parity is not established.
implementation: Binding 28 holds bodyA/bodyB, absolute point start, count with sphere flag, normal and friction. Both standalone packing and fused persistence refresh it. Compact primal/dual no longer read colliders or canonical manifolds. Canonical persistence retains collider identity and full feature IDs.
memoryTradeoff: 32 bytes per candidate capacity; 64 MiB extra allocation for ring110k. Canonical scenes allocate a 32-byte placeholder. This is temporary solver metadata, not persistent compact contacts.
conditions: Serial Chrome 155 in-app browser on Apple M3 Max/Metal-3. No native GPU tests or compilation overlap the timed runs. Control retains the same host allocations but does not read or write the pair cache.
profilingCaveat: Phase medians come from later split-pass timestamp samples with readback. They perturb execution and are separate from throughput batches.
